body: Special City Council meeting - Housing/Rental Assistance
agenda_text:
NOTICE AND AGENDA
  FOR SPECIAL MEETING

  CITY COUNCIL

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor of the City of Norwalk has called a special
  meeting of the City Council beginning at 9 a.m. on November 18, 2023 in U.S. Constitution Room
  #4, Norwalk City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard. The agenda for the special meeting is as
  follows:

  (Members of the public are entitled to speak only on the items listed. Please fill out a speaker
  card and turn it in to the City Clerk before the meeting commences.)

  CALL TO ORDER / FLAG SALUTE  Mayor Valencia

  ROLL CALL  City Clerk

  REPORTS

  1. HOMELESS PLAN PRESENTATION – Receive and file.

  2. RENT STABILIZATION – Discussion and next steps.

  Dated this 16th day of November 2023.

  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

  I, Theresa Devoy, City Clerk, hereby certify that the foregoing notice of special meeting was posted at City
  Hall not less than 24-hours before the start of the meeting and delivered to each member of the Norwalk
  City Council and to the following newspapers: Herald American, Cerritos Community News, Norwalk
  Patriot, and Whittier Daily News, all on the 16th day of November 2023.

  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it has been
posted will also be made available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s Department.

Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address the City Council on any matter listed on the agenda.

Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
documents in the agenda packet, can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
Notification of at least 12 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
